headline: Palantir Stock Edges Lower Wednesday: What's Driving the Move?
summary: Palantir shares are trading lower on Wednesday as traders digest a sharp, weeklong run-up and some profit-taking.

headline: Tesla, Palantir Fall as CPI Sends September Fed Hike Odds to 33%
summary: Tesla and Palantir fell after July CPI pushed September Fed hike odds below 42%, even as the report lifted the broader tech market.
